_comment: UltimateTicTacToe locale file. DO NOT translate keys (left side). Only translate values (right side). Keep every {placeholder} exactly as-is. Move tokens like [7 8] and the board are not translated.

_slots.{symbol}: The player's mark, X or O
_slots.{micro}: The square index (0-8) inside the mini-board
_slots.{next_target}: A rendered phrase naming where the opponent must play next
_slots.{n}: A mini-board index the opponent is forced into
_slots.{board}: The rendered ASCII board (do not translate)

player_prompt.intro:
You are Player {player_id} in **Ultimate Tic Tac Toe**.
Submit your move as **[macro  micro]** (two numbers 0-8):
• *macro*  = which mini-board you play in
• *micro* = which square inside that mini-board
Example `[7 8]` ➜ place your mark in mini-board 7, square 8, and
force your opponent to play in mini-board 8 next.

You are `{symbol}`.

invalid_move.wrong_format: Move must be in the form [macro micro] with numbers 0-8.
invalid_move.out_of_range: Indices must each be between 0 and 8.
invalid_move.range_recheck: The micro_board, row, or col is out of range.
invalid_move.wrong_board: The player must play in the next micro board.
invalid_move.board_won: The micro board is already won.

game_action.played: Player {player_id} played in micro board {macro}, cell {micro} (row {row}, col {col}). Player {opponent_id} must now play in {next_target}.

outcome.win: Player {player_id} wins Ultimate Tic Tac Toe!
